scope: Prepared OuchiCore API and flow, not a shipping UI/server route. No deletion completion state exists.
transport: Exact per-action POST JSON <=4096 bytes, no redirects, original response URL and canonical scope/kind/states, bounded default URLSession resource timeout, cancellation. 404 is only absent matching review; request never accepts it.
custody: Binding contains accountID/epochID/submissionID only. Caller must persist and read back exact binding before submission. Default persistence rejects. Unknown/pending submission cannot silently renew; explicit retry only after confirmed absent review, explicit new request only after cancelled receipt. Same-account session revision retains custody but invalidates results.
identity: Late response after account/epoch/revision changes discarded; reentrant identity change during save prevents dispatch. No bearer/password is saved in binding.

verified.scope: macOS Swift package compile + mocked transport and injected persistence. Restored binding is in-memory fixture, not Keychain/restart or real Auth HTTP proof.
